This file visualises posterior distributions for the three exploratory LBA
models for Experiment 4: bias (A varies by response), t0 (non-decision time
varies by condition), and full (both A and t0 vary).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "EMC2", "tidyverse", "tidybayes", "patchwork", "paletteer", "here"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )

theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
)

safe_pal   <- paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe", 4)

myColors_2 <- c("novel" = safe_pal[1], "famous" = safe_pal[3])
```

# 1. Load models

```{r}
#| label: load-models

if (Sys.getenv("OSF_PAT") != "") osfr::osf_auth(Sys.getenv("OSF_PAT"))

exp4_models <- osfr::osf_retrieve_node("65bt2") |>
  osfr::osf_ls_files() |>
  dplyr::filter(name == "exp_4") |>
  osfr::osf_ls_files() |>
  osfr::osf_ls_files()

local_dir <- here("exp_4", "models")
if (!dir.exists(local_dir)) dir.create(local_dir, recursive = TRUE)

model_files <- c(
  "LBA_exp4_bias.RData",
  "LBA_exp4_t0.RData",
  "LBA_exp4_full.RData"
)

walk(model_files, ~ {
  if (!file.exists(here(local_dir, .x))) {
    exp4_models |>
      dplyr::filter(name == .x) |>
      osfr::osf_download(path = local_dir, conflicts = "overwrite")
  }
})

load(here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_bias.RData"))
load(here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_t0.RData"))
load(here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_full.RData"))
```

# 2. Wrangling function

```{r}
#| label: wrangle-fn

wrangle_model <- function(model, param_cols, cond_label = "famous") {
  params  <- EMC2::parameters(model, selection = "alpha", N = NULL)
  n_pids  <- length(unique(params$subjects))
  n_draws <- nrow(params) / n_pids

  # pid-level posteriors
  theta_pid <- params |>
    as_tibble() |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = all_of(param_cols),
      names_to  = "param",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    rename(pid = subjects) |>
    mutate(
      pid   = as.integer(factor(pid)),
      .draw = rep(1:n_draws, each = length(param_cols), times = n_pids)
    )

  # group-level posteriors
  theta_group <- theta_pid |>
    group_by(.draw, param) |>
    summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # helpers to recode response/condition labels from param names
  recode_response <- function(param) {
    case_when(
      str_detect(param, "lRNovel")  ~ "novel",
      str_detect(param, "lRFamous") ~ "famous"
    )
  }

  recode_condition <- function(param) {
    case_when(
      str_detect(param, "SNovel")  ~ "novel",
      str_detect(param, "SFamous") ~ "famous"
    )
  }

  # ── threshold ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  thresh_group <- theta_group |>
    filter(str_detect(param, "B_")) |>
    mutate(
      response = recode_response(param),
      response = factor(response, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
    )

  thresh_diff_group <- thresh_group |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = .draw, names_from = response, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])

  thresh_diff_pid <- theta_pid |>
    filter(str_detect(param, "B_")) |>
    mutate(
      response = recode_response(param),
      response = factor(response, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pid, .draw), names_from = response, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])

  # ── drift rate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  drift_group <- theta_group |>
    filter(str_detect(param, "v_S")) |>
    mutate(
      condition = recode_condition(param),
      accuracy  = if_else(str_detect(param, "TRUE"), "true", "false"),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("novel", cond_label)),
      accuracy  = factor(accuracy,  levels = c("false", "true"))
    )

  drift_acc_diff_group <- drift_group |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(.draw, condition),
      names_from  = accuracy,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    mutate(diff = true - false)

  drift_cond_diff_group <- drift_acc_diff_group |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = .draw, names_from = condition, values_from = diff) |>
    mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])

  drift_cond_diff_pid <- theta_pid |>
    filter(str_detect(param, "v_S")) |>
    mutate(
      condition = recode_condition(param),
      accuracy  = if_else(str_detect(param, "TRUE"), "true", "false"),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("novel", cond_label)),
      accuracy  = factor(accuracy,  levels = c("false", "true"))
    ) |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(pid, .draw, condition),
      names_from  = accuracy,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    mutate(diff = true - false) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pid, .draw), names_from = condition, values_from = diff) |>
    mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])

  # ── optional: bias (A) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bias <- NULL
  if (any(str_detect(param_cols, "A_"))) {
    bias_group <- theta_group |>
      filter(str_detect(param, "A_")) |>
      mutate(
        response = recode_response(param),
        response = factor(response, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
      )
    bias_diff_group <- bias_group |>
      pivot_wider(id_cols = .draw, names_from = response, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])
    bias_diff_pid <- theta_pid |>
      filter(str_detect(param, "A_")) |>
      mutate(
        response = recode_response(param),
        response = factor(response, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pid, .draw), names_from = response, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])
    bias <- list(
      group    = bias_group,
      diff     = bias_diff_group,
      diff_pid = bias_diff_pid,
      diff_q   = bias_diff_group |> median_qi(diff)
    )
  }

  # ── optional: t0 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  t0 <- NULL
  if (any(str_detect(param_cols, "t0_"))) {
    t0_group <- theta_group |>
      filter(str_detect(param, "t0_")) |>
      mutate(
        condition = recode_condition(param),
        condition = factor(condition, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
      )
    t0_diff_group <- t0_group |>
      pivot_wider(id_cols = .draw, names_from = condition, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])
    t0_diff_pid <- theta_pid |>
      filter(str_detect(param, "t0_")) |>
      mutate(
        condition = recode_condition(param),
        condition = factor(condition, levels = c("novel", cond_label))
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(id_cols = c(pid, .draw), names_from = condition, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(diff = novel - .data[[cond_label]])
    t0 <- list(
      group    = t0_group,
      diff     = t0_diff_group,
      diff_pid = t0_diff_pid,
      diff_q   = t0_diff_group |> median_qi(diff)
    )
  }

  list(
    thresh = list(
      group    = thresh_group,
      diff     = thresh_diff_group,
      diff_pid = thresh_diff_pid,
      diff_q   = thresh_diff_group |> median_qi(diff)
    ),
    drift = list(
      acc_diff      = drift_acc_diff_group,
      cond_diff     = drift_cond_diff_group,
      cond_diff_pid = drift_cond_diff_pid,
      acc_diff_q    = drift_acc_diff_group  |> group_by(condition) |> median_qi(diff),
      cond_diff_q   = drift_cond_diff_group |> median_qi(diff)
    ),
    bias = bias,
    t0   = t0
  )
}
```

# 3. Plotting function

```{r}
#| label: plot-fn

plot_effects <- function(res, model_name, cond_label = "famous",
                         fig_dir = here("exp_4", "figures", "exploratory")) {

  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # threshold
  p_thresh_dist <- ggplot(
    res$thresh$group,
    aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(response), fill = response)
  ) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = myColors_2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = "Threshold", y = "Response",
         title = paste(model_name, "— threshold"))

  p_thresh_diff <- ggplot(res$thresh$diff, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.9, fill = "firebrick") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = paste0("Threshold (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = NULL)

  p_thresh_pid <- ggplot(
    res$thresh$diff_pid |> mutate(pid = reorder(pid, diff, mean)),
    aes(x = diff, y = pid)
  ) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = paste0("Threshold (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = "Participant")

  p_thresh <- p_thresh_dist | p_thresh_diff | p_thresh_pid
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("threshold_", model_name, ".jpeg")),
         p_thresh, width = 15, height = 6)

  # drift rate
  p_drift_dist <- ggplot(
    res$drift$acc_diff,
    aes(x = diff, y = fct_rev(condition), fill = condition)
  ) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = myColors_2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = "Drift rate (true - false)", y = "Condition",
         title = paste(model_name, "— drift rate"))

  p_drift_diff <- ggplot(res$drift$cond_diff, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.9, fill = "firebrick") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = paste0("Drift rate (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = NULL)

  p_drift_pid <- ggplot(
    res$drift$cond_diff_pid |> mutate(pid = reorder(pid, diff, mean)),
    aes(x = diff, y = pid)
  ) +
    stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
    labs(x = paste0("Drift rate (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = "Participant")

  p_drift <- p_drift_dist | p_drift_diff | p_drift_pid
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("drift_rate_", model_name, ".jpeg")),
         p_drift, width = 15, height = 6)

  # bias (if present)
  if (!is.null(res$bias)) {
    p_bias_dist <- ggplot(
      res$bias$group,
      aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(response), fill = response)
    ) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = myColors_2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = "Starting point (A)", y = "Response",
           title = paste(model_name, "— bias"))

    p_bias_diff <- ggplot(res$bias$diff, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.9, fill = "firebrick") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = paste0("Bias (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = NULL)

    p_bias_pid <- ggplot(
      res$bias$diff_pid |> mutate(pid = reorder(pid, diff, mean)),
      aes(x = diff, y = pid)
    ) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = paste0("Bias (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = "Participant")

    p_bias <- p_bias_dist | p_bias_diff | p_bias_pid
    ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("bias_", model_name, ".jpeg")),
           p_bias, width = 15, height = 6)
  }

  # t0 (if present)
  if (!is.null(res$t0)) {
    p_t0_dist <- ggplot(
      res$t0$group,
      aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(condition), fill = condition)
    ) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = myColors_2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = "Non-decision time (t0)", y = "Condition",
           title = paste(model_name, "— t0"))

    p_t0_diff <- ggplot(res$t0$diff, aes(x = diff, y = "")) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.9, fill = "firebrick") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = paste0("t0 (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = NULL)

    p_t0_pid <- ggplot(
      res$t0$diff_pid |> mutate(pid = reorder(pid, diff, mean)),
      aes(x = diff, y = pid)
    ) +
      stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey") +
      labs(x = paste0("t0 (novel - ", cond_label, ")"), y = "Participant")

    p_t0 <- p_t0_dist | p_t0_diff | p_t0_pid
    ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("t0_", model_name, ".jpeg")),
           p_t0, width = 15, height = 6)
  }

  print(p_thresh)
  print(p_drift)
  if (!is.null(res$bias)) print(p_bias)
  if (!is.null(res$t0))   print(p_t0)
}
```

# 4. Run for each model

```{r}
#| label: effects-bias

res_bias <- wrangle_model(
  model      = LBA_exp4_bias,
  param_cols = c(
    "v_SNovel:lMTRUE", "v_SNovel:lMFALSE",
    "v_SFamous:lMTRUE", "v_SFamous:lMFALSE",
    "sv_lMTRUE", "B_lRNovel", "B_lRFamous",
    "A_lRNovel", "A_lRFamous", "t0"
  )
)
plot_effects(res_bias, model_name = "bias")
```

```{r}
#| label: effects-t0

res_t0 <- wrangle_model(
  model      = LBA_exp4_t0,
  param_cols = c(
    "v_SNovel:lMTRUE", "v_SNovel:lMFALSE",
    "v_SFamous:lMTRUE", "v_SFamous:lMFALSE",
    "sv_lMTRUE", "B_lRNovel", "B_lRFamous",
    "A", "t0_SNovel", "t0_SFamous"
  )
)
plot_effects(res_t0, model_name = "t0")
```

```{r}
#| label: effects-full

res_full <- wrangle_model(
  model      = LBA_exp4_full,
  param_cols = c(
    "v_SNovel:lMTRUE", "v_SNovel:lMFALSE",
    "v_SFamous:lMTRUE", "v_SFamous:lMFALSE",
    "sv_lMTRUE", "B_lRNovel", "B_lRFamous",
    "A_lRNovel", "A_lRFamous",
    "t0_SNovel", "t0_SFamous"
  )
)
plot_effects(res_full, model_name = "full")
```

# 5. Summary quantiles

```{r}
#| label: quantiles

# threshold
bind_rows(
  res_bias$thresh$diff_q |> mutate(model = "bias"),
  res_t0$thresh$diff_q   |> mutate(model = "t0"),
  res_full$thresh$diff_q |> mutate(model = "full")
) |>
  select(model, median = diff, lower = .lower, upper = .upper)

# drift rate contrast
bind_rows(
  res_bias$drift$cond_diff_q |> mutate(model = "bias"),
  res_t0$drift$cond_diff_q   |> mutate(model = "t0"),
  res_full$drift$cond_diff_q |> mutate(model = "full")
) |>
  select(model, median = diff, lower = .lower, upper = .upper)
```

# 6. Model comparison

```{r}
#| label: model-comparison

load(here("exp_4", "models", "LBA_exp4_v1.RData"))

compare(
  list(
    preregistered = LBA_exp4_v1,
    bias          = LBA_exp4_bias,
    t0            = LBA_exp4_t0,
    full          = LBA_exp4_full
  ),
  cores_per_prop = 2
)
```
